# DocentPro

> > DocentPro provides audio walking tours and travel reels for cultural exploration, featuring destinations across South Korea, Berlin, Jerusalem, Hanoi, and beyond.

The platform combines curated audio-guided tours of historical landmarks and cultural sites with user-generated travel reels. Key content includes Seoul attractions, Jewish heritage sites, and immersive cultural experiences created by travel guides like chrisbg.

## Key Topics

- Audio walking tours
- Seoul attractions
- South Korea travel
- Korea travel guides
- Historical landmarks
- Jewish heritage sites
- Holocaust memorials
- Cultural tours
- Berlin history
- Travel reels
- Hiking and national parks
- Activity tours
- Temple tours
- World War II history
- User-generated travel content

## Audio Walking Tours

- [Berlin's Historic Heart: A Journey Through Time and Culture](https://docentpro.com/docent-groups/berlins-historic-heart-a-journey-through-time-and-culture_Mjg): Audio walking tour of Berlin's Jewish heritage & Holocaust memorial sites
- [Jerusalem: A Sacred Journey Through the Holy City](https://docentpro.com/docent-groups/jerusalem-a-sacred-journey-through-the-holy-city_NzM): Audio tour of Jerusalem's holy sites & Church of the Holy Sepulchre
- [Hanoi's Cultural Tapestry: A Journey Through History and Heritage](https://docentpro.com/docent-groups/hanois-cultural-tapestry-a-journey-through-history-and-herit_NjY): Audio walking tour: Hanoi's Temple of Literature & Confucian heritage

- [Seoul Plaza - Squid Game 3 Finale Parade](https://docentpro.com/videos/seoul-plaza_3492080d-d566-48ca-b51b-caeff223dc9f): Squid Game 3 finale parade at Seoul Plaza with Lee Jung-jae appearance
